name: GridPatch Electrical Crew Dayside Full Kit
description: The daily rig of a GridPatch Infrastructure electrical maintenance crew member — the people who keep Meridian's power grid from folding under the city's perpetual load. The foundation is a flame-resistant (FR-rated) work shirt in sun-faded mustard yellow, long-sleeve, with pearl-snap closures rather than metal buttons to reduce arc hazard, double chest pockets with snap flaps, and a GridPatch utility patch embroidered on the left chest. The shirt's right cuff has been pre-modified with a velcro breakaway closure, a standard accommodation for workers with chrome forearm augmentation who need to quickly expose hardware. Over this, a lightweight FR-rated vest in charcoal with a mesh back panel for ventilation, four front pockets, and a broad strip of retroreflective tape across the upper back. The vest's rear collar has a reinforced loop for attaching a hardhat retention strap. Trousers are heavy-duty FR canvas in tan, straight-cut with gusseted crotch for full movement, a hammer loop on the left thigh, and multiple cargo pockets sealed with metal-free hook-and-loop closures. Boots are insulated, dielectric-rated (non-conductive) lace-up work boots in brown leather-analog with a composite (non-metal) toe cap. A yellow hard hat with a GridPatch decal rides on the head on-site, clipped to the vest when off. Nitrile-coated work gloves tuck into the vest pocket when not worn.
functionality: full flame-resistant construction, dielectric non-conductive boot, composite non-metal toe cap, breakaway velcro cuff for chrome arm accommodation, metal-free hardware throughout to reduce arc hazard, hardhat retention loop, retroreflective hi-vis strip, ventilated vest back panel, tool loops
what_it_says: Electrical infrastructure work is one of the more respected Circuit trades — technically demanding and genuinely dangerous. This kit marks the wearer as someone with a specialty, not just a body filling a shift. The sun-faded yellow of the shirt says years on the job; the immaculate condition of the dielectric boots says they haven't gotten careless yet.
manufacturer: GridPatch Infrastructure Services (vest, hard hat, gloves — issued) / independent FR workwear suppliers (shirt, trousers, boots — personal purchase, company-spec required)
price_range: Φ250–Φ380 (FR-rated materials carry a premium; boots alone Φ90–Φ130)
story_hooks: A crew member's dielectric boots have been tampered with — the non-conductive sole compromised in a way that looks like wear but isn't, and they're scheduled to work a live substation tomorrow.

The GridPatch vest's pocket contains an inspection report that was never filed — documenting a section of grid infrastructure that is critically degraded and has been signed off as stable by someone up the chain.
The breakaway cuff on the right sleeve keeps triggering at the wrong moment, exposing a chrome forearm that carries illegal modification — military-grade actuators that no Circuit worker should have.
